textPlacement.assessment: The short summary stands on its own as an attributed, supervised possibility with a concrete salad-leaf example. It creates no expectation to cut food, complete a meal or remain engaged. The cue and detail retain brief participation, adult help, leaving when interest ends and a low/dining-table alternative. The corrected final paragraph explicitly attributes sharper knives with a cutting guide to Davies’s preschooler context and retains supervision and out-of-reach storage; the general age/readiness text therefore does not become an authorization for sharper knives at 18–24 months. The separate apple example remains qualified by adult assistance and the from-two-years description, without prescribing a new cutting sequence. Warmth, manageable participation and help remain present alongside the necessary source qualifications, with no buying requirement, performance target, outside care advice or warning-sheet rewrite.
